blocks.text: Scottsdale homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Scottsdale, September 2026. Detached houses: 53 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 19% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 24 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 30 over 4 months against an average of 52.0 listed, about 6.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 10 sold. condos and townhomes sold 9 over 4 months against an average of 25.2 listed, about 11.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 6 sold.
